entries.dialogueText: Titus pushed the door open with a firm hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seeing him up close, I noticed the..."
entries.dialogueText: Seeing him up close, I noticed the scar that cut across his nose. His unkempt beard and rugged olive-green coat looked out of place in the polished room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes scanned the surroundings b..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes scanned the surroundings briefly before locking onto mine.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don’t you know that you must bow w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t you know that you must bow when your King enters?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He didn't flinch. His lips curled s..."
entries.dialogueText: He didn't flinch. His lips curled slightly with a brief flicker of amusement.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I advise you to choose your next w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I advise you to choose your next words carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're nothing like what I expecte..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're nothing like what I expected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to see you here, House Speake..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to see you here, House Speaker."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I'll take that as a compliment.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll take that as a compliment."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I appreciate the opportunity to co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the opportunity to converse with you directly. Thank you for inviting me here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To be frank, I never thought I'd b..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be frank, I never thought I'd be hosting a revolutionary in this palace. But these are extraordinary times."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Indeed not. But the people's voice..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed not. But the people's voice has grown louder, reaching ears in places it once couldn't."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled slightly. There was somet..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled slightly. There was something almost disarming about the way he stood -- confident, yet ill at ease in the grandeur of our surroundings.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for accepting my invitat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for accepting my invitation. It’s not every day that a Malenyevist and a King come together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how is everything in the House..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how is everything in the House of Delegates, Mr. Speaker?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you are doing something to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are doing something to contain the unrest in the streets, Mr. Sotelato."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Loud or not, I am still your King.""
entries.dialogueText: "Loud or not, I am still your King."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""How could I forget that?""
entries.dialogueText: "How could I forget that?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Delegates have been calling fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Delegates have been calling for comprehensive democratic reforms for a while now. Calls that have gone unanswered."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo’s smile faded slightly, repl..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo’s smile faded slightly, replaced by a serious expression.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It seems that voice has found a fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems that voice has found a formidable representative in you, Mr. Sotelato."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The people’s struggles are my own,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people’s struggles are my own, Your Majesty. I've lived them."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And now, I aim to ensure their cri..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now, I aim to ensure their cries will no longer go unheard."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo’s smile faded slightly, repl..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo’s smile faded slightly, replaced by a serious expression.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stared directly at me."
entries.dialogueText: He stared directly at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then tell me... what *does* it loo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then tell me... what *does* it look like?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I don't bow to relics, Romus Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't bow to relics, Romus Toras. Not anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So... you're the man who wants to..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... you're the man who wants to put me out of a job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are in the presence of your Ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are in the presence of your King. If you wish to address me, you will bow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are a guest in my palace, Adar..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are a guest in my palace, Adarfo. You may claim not to bow to relics, but royal tradition still matters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've seen relics survive longer th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've seen relics survive longer than revolutions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw his fingers twitch, the only..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw his fingers twitch, the only hint that my demand had struck a nerve.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He remained standing, arms crossed."
entries.dialogueText: He remained standing, arms crossed.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I prefer to think of it as dismant..."
entries.dialogueText: "I prefer to think of it as dismantling the machineries of oppression."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He didn't so much as flinch. His li..."
entries.dialogueText: He didn't so much as flinch. His lips curled slightly with a brief flicker of amusement.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that what you tell yourself? Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that what you tell yourself? That refusing to bow furthers your cause somehow? It’s a petulant defiance, Adarfo -- a child playing at revolution."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw his fingers twitch, the only..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw his fingers twitch, the only hint that my demand had struck a nerve.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Relics become relics because they..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relics become relics because they outlive their purpose."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A cold smile formed on his lips."
entries.dialogueText: A cold smile formed on his lips.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Tradition? It’s tradition that’s k..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tradition? It’s tradition that’s kept this country in chains. And you expect me to bow to it?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I stand in the presence of a man w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand in the presence of a man who has summoned me for a meeting. A request that I have honored by coming here."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""So let me address you as that man,..."
entries.dialogueText: "So let me address you as that man, because that's all you are."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Let me address you as an equal. Af..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me address you as an equal. After all, the only difference between us is that you happen to have been born into privilege."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And that’s all your monarchy is --..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that’s all your monarchy is -- an outdated symbol. You’re a man like any other, Romus, so let me address you as an equal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Address me however you like, Mr. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Address me however you like, Mr. Sotelato, but know that I'm not your enemy. Now, please take a seat."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his arms and gestured at..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his arms and gestured at our surroundings.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A man, yes. But a man who holds a..."
entries.dialogueText: "A man, yes. But a man who holds a nation together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's far easier to criticize someo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's far easier to criticize someone's leadership than to wear the crown yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And refusing to bow to your King i..."
entries.dialogueText: "And refusing to bow to your King is part of that quest? It’s a petulant defiance, Adarfo -- a child playing at revolution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Dismantling the machineries of op..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Dismantling the machineries of oppression?' You've been reading too many manifestos."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Criticism is what the powerless us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Criticism is what the powerless use until they’re given the tools to change the system."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Defiance isn't childish. It’s a ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defiance isn't childish. It’s a necessity in the face of tyranny."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And the people are learning to sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the people are learning to stand up to those who would prefer them to prostrate themselves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised an eyebrow and nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He raised an eyebrow and nodded.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You’d do well to read a few yourse..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’d do well to read a few yourself. Maybe then you’d realize that they aren't mere theories, but the lived experiences of your people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we're going to have a real conv..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we're going to have a real conversation, I think we can both agree that mutual respect is the first step. And respect means following basic decorum."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You might find the conversation mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might find the conversation more productive if you sit. We’re both here to discuss the future of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. Stand. Like a soldier awaiti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Stand. Like a soldier awaiting orders."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I appreciate the thought, but I’m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the thought, but I’m here to make my position clear. Sitting doesn't change what’s coming."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Thank you, but the people I repres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, but the people I represent aren't concerned with decorum. It's just another of the chains that are binding us."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You'll find that I'm not so easily..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll find that I'm not so easily provoked. I didn't come here to be baited into an argument."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So be it, Adarfo. Address me howev..."
entries.dialogueText: "So be it, Adarfo. Address me however you like. Now, please take a seat."

entries.dialogueText: "If you really mean what you say, Your Majesty, I believe we can have a respectful dialogue."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Really? Because demanding a gestur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? Because demanding a gesture of submission right from the start sends a rather different signal."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But if you are indeed here to list..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you are indeed here to listen, we can have a respectful dialogue."

entries.dialogueText: "You think that once you get rid of me and put yourself in power, everything will just fall into place?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "The monarchy you scorn is the same institution that has kept this nation intact through war, famine, and countless other hardships."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But if you are indeed here to have..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you are indeed here to have that conversation, Your Majesty, we can have a respectful dialogue."

entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""It’s hard to believe that when you..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s hard to believe that when you greet me so dismissively right from the start."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""We have a new vision for Rizia. On..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have a new vision for Rizia. One in which nobody wears a crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand what you're getting a..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Power isn't the end goal. Justice..."
entries.dialogueText: "Power isn't the end goal. Justice is."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The people have seen enough to kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people have seen enough to know what real freedom looks like..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""...And it doesn't look like this.""
entries.dialogueText: "...And it doesn't look like this."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But now it’s falling apart. Stabil..."
entries.dialogueText: "But now it’s falling apart. Stability built on injustice can’t last forever."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.dialogueText: "You think the people will wait much longer for promises of reform? They’re already in the streets, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""How can you say that when your own..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you say that when your own people have taken to the streets in open defiance of your authority?"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You are the last obstacle standing..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are the last obstacle standing in this country's way."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.dialogueText: "Instead of focusing on symbols of power, Your Excellency..."

entries.dialogueText: "...Would you be kind enough to tell me what you intend to achieve by summoning me here?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.dialogueText: "Our vision is to build a fair and just society. And such a change has to come from the people."

entries.dialogueText: "But most importantly, the people need to know if *you* have the vision to listen and let go of power."

entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And? Do you see a man, or a threat?""
entries.dialogueText: "And? Do you see a man, or a threat?"

entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Thousands are marching for their r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thousands are marching for their rights as we speak. Because they now know the monarchy can’t be reformed. It needs to be dismantled."

entries.dialogueText: "Thousands on the streets may seem like a victory to you, but it's nothing to me. If you think your mob is immune from the Crown's justice, you're living in a fantasy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you’re right. Maybe the time of monarchies has passed. If the people no longer believe in the Crown, then what’s left of it?"

entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about me. It’s the people's courage that drives this movement. Any one of them could be standing here in my stead."

entries.dialogueText: "But they're not. You are the one who must face the full weight of the Crown’s justice."

entries.dialogueText: "And what happened to Mr. Sazon, who thought he could compromise with his noble peers? His half-measures and moderate views couldn't save him."

entries.dialogueText: "If you're willing to step aside peacefully, you can still help shape the future of this nation, rather than be swept away by it."

entries.dialogueText: "We've seen what happens when revolutions promise freedom. They leave nothing but rubble behind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Before we continue, why don't you sit down? We’re both here to discuss Rizia's future."

entries.dialogueText: "Really? I think it looks rather nice."

entries.dialogueText: "An open field where healthy, well-fed children play. A factory owned and operated by the workers themselves. An apartment block whose residents don't have to struggle to pay their rent anymore."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The system is already rubble. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "The system is already rubble. And it's crumbling further under the weight of inequality and greed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For a moment he seemed noticeably a..."
entries.dialogueText: For a moment he seemed noticeably agitated, before he took a deep breath and continued.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see nobody. And nobody will ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see nobody. And nobody will ever see you again. GUARDS!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see both. A man with conviction,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see both. A man with conviction, and a threat to this country's order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I see a man who believes in his cause, and maybe he is right to believe in it."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Thousands are marching for this ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thousands are marching for this cause as we speak. Because they now know the monarchy can’t be reformed. It needs to be dismantled."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see a man who's stirring up unre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see a man who's stirring up unrest in order to catapult himself into power."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The threat to this country is the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The threat to this country is the handful of people who hold all the power. Yourself included."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You're too used to things being do..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're too used to things being done top-to-bottom that you cannot comprehend people organizing themselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You look troubled, Adarfo. I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "You look troubled, Adarfo. I hope you didn't underestimate the situation you walked into."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's the matter? Lost for words?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the matter? Lost for words? It’s easy to talk of revolution, but when faced with the reality of power, things become much less poetic, don't they?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""...But we don't want that to happe..."
entries.dialogueText: "...But we don't want that to happen now, do we?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept silent and waited for him to..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept silent and waited for him to respond.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Maybe you think the ‘Crown's justi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe you think the ‘Crown's justice’ is enough to keep the people in line, but they're past the point of fear."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""No, we don't. But what you fail to..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, we don't. But what you fail to see is that this isn't about what you or I want anymore."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I don't think this is the time for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think this is the time for you to throw around threats."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You think I'm afraid? The people a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think I'm afraid? The people are beyond fear, and so am I. It's not me you should worry about."
